blog.title: Optimizing your online store for a maximum to sales impact your business to the world.
blog.description: Optimizing your online store for maximum sales impact and exposure involves a multifaceted approach & incorporating a blog can be a crucial aspect.
blog.content:
Optimizing your online store for maximum sales impact & exposure involves a multifaceted approach & incorporating a blog can be a crucial aspect of that strategy. Here's a detailed breakdown of how to leverage a blog to enhance your online store's performance:

1. Mobile Optimization
Ensure your online store is mobile-friendly, as a significant portion of online shopping occurs on mobile devices. Optimize your website design and user experience for smartphones and tablets to maximize accessibility and conversion rates.

2. Search Engine Optimization
Implement SEO best practices to improve your website's visibility in search engine results. This includes optimizing product descriptions, meta tags & URLs as well as building quality backlinks & creating valuable content that aligns with relevant keywords.

3. Review & Testimonials
Display customer reviews and testimonials prominently on your website to build trust and credibility. Positive reviews can reassure potential buyers and encourage them to complete their purchase.

4. Social Media Marketing
Leverage social media platforms to promote your online store & engage with your target audience. Create compelling content, run targeted ad campaigns, and actively interact with followers to drive traffic and generate sales.

faq.question: How long does an AgotaSoft ERP setup take?
faq.answer: Depending on the size of your business and the number of modules, setup is usually completed within 2-4 weeks, including data migration, user training and integration testing.

faq.question: Can we migrate data from our current system to AgotaSoft?
faq.answer: Yes. We securely migrate your current-account, inventory, invoice and customer data from Excel, your existing ERP/accounting software and other sources. Migration is managed by our expert team.

faq.question: How secure is our data?
faq.answer: All data is protected with 256-bit SSL encryption, backed up regularly and hosted on ISO 27001-compliant infrastructure. Role-based permissions let you decide who can access what.

faq.question: Can we turn off the AI features?
faq.answer: Yes. AgotaSoft solutions work in both AI-assisted and classic mode. AI suggestions, automations and smart reporting are entirely optional — you can run the system fully manually if you prefer.

faq.question: Which payment methods do you support?
faq.answer: We accept credit card and bank transfer for monthly or annual subscriptions. Enterprise packages can also be invoiced.

faq.question: How many users can we start with?
faq.answer: You can start with a single user and increase your user count anytime as your business grows. See our pricing page for package details.

faq.question: Do you support Turkish e-invoice (GİB) integration?
faq.answer: Yes, the AgotaSoft Bookkeeping module is fully integrated with Turkey's e-invoice authority (GİB); you can run e-invoice, e-archive invoice and e-waybill processes directly from the system.

faq.question: How does support work?
faq.answer: All customers get email and phone support; enterprise packages include 24/7 priority support. We provide free training for your team after setup.

faq.question: Is there a free demo or trial period?
faq.answer: Yes, you can request a free demo for any of our products and try the system without entering card details. Trial length ranges from 14-30 days depending on the product.

faq.question: Can we access it from mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, all AgotaSoft products work in a mobile-friendly browser experience; ERP and CRM also offer dedicated mobile apps.
